variables.label: Current stance
variables.description: The agent's opinion position on the policy after this period. -1 = fully aligned with the persuaders' view (the policy should be rejected), +1 = fully supports the policy, 0 = neutral. Mutable: it moves by the judged persuasion increment of every influence the agent receives, so it can change in every period.

variables.label: Adopted (view flipped)
variables.description: 1 once the agent's preference state has flipped to the persuaders' side (it crossed the adoption threshold). Sticky: once 1 it stays 1 for the rest of the episode, so this is 'has ever adopted', not 'adopted this period'.

variables.label: Influences received
variables.description: How many influence events have reached this agent so far (from persuaders or from other agents it is connected to). Each one is a judged persuasion attempt whose increment can move the stance.

variables.label: Net stance push received
variables.description: Sum of the signed persuasion increments this agent has received. Negative = pushed toward the persuaders' view. Differs from the stance change itself, which is clipped to [-1, +1] and gated by the acceptance rule.

variables.label: Influences from a persuader
variables.description: The subset of influences that came directly from one of the 5 RL persuaders rather than from a converted crowd agent.

variables.label: Adoption events
variables.description: How many individual influence events this agent adopted on (normally 0 or 1: the event that flipped it).

static_variables.label: Role
static_variables.description: persuader = one of the RL-controlled campaign accounts that the policy drives; organic = a crowd agent that can only be influenced.

static_variables.label: Network degree
static_variables.description: Number of neighbours in the interaction graph, i.e. how many agents can directly influence it (and how many it can pass a message on to).

static_variables.label: Initial stance
static_variables.description: The agent's stance before any influence (period t0).

static_variables.label: Persona leaning
static_variables.description: The synthetic persona's political leaning, used by the persuader policy as part of the target observation.

static_variables.label: Persona profile
static_variables.description: The synthetic profile used to condition message generation and judge scoring for this agent.
